obligations.description: Prove a uniform relevance-preserving augmentation recurrence on complements U_n.
Give uniform poly(2^n)-time membership for U_n and hence associated G_n.
Bind rho(G_n) to f_{G_n} with the exact source rate.
Supply an NP verifier for f_{G_n} or a separate lower-bound-preserving NP reduction.
Achieve a superpolynomial lower bound in the NP input length.

known_disanalogies: U_n is the complement object for relevance, whereas G_n is the graph transferred to Boolean complexity.
Poly(n) decidability of f_{G_n} forbids its superpolynomial circuit target.
Uniform 2^{O(n)} membership yields E, not automatically NP.
cheapest_hostile_world: A uniform complement family U_n may yield a valid lower bound for rho(G_n) and f_{G_n} in E while no NP verifier or reduction is known.
